title: Inhabile
summary: INHAB'ILE, adjective [Latin inhabilis; in and habilis, apt, fit.] 1. Not apt or fit; unfit; not convenient; as inhabile matter. 2. Unskilled; unready; unqualified; used of persons. [Little used. See U
